methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
proposes and describes integrated approach to 
motivate municipalities to engage and apply a systematic approach towards energy reduction

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Proposes an integrated EnMS (ISO 50001) + SEAP management framework for municipalities and reports qualitative implementation lessons across 41 municipalities; energy performance indicators (MWh/capita, tCO2/capita) appear only incidentally to illustrate trends, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised (no baseline/normalisation model, variables, functional form, or estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote:
Proposed methodology of 
the integrated EnMS and SEAP approach

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: per-capita EnPIs (MWh/capita, tCO2/capita) present but incidental; classified ineligible as an EnMS+SEAP management-framework paper. paper_type framework vs multi-case (41 municipalities) is arguable.
